task_name: Collect Special Item from Opinion Bubble and Upgrade City Storage Capacity

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When popping a blue citizen thought bubble rewards a Storage Camera (1/1) and you want to expand City Storage capacity from 40 to 45.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Increasing City Storage capacity prevents 'Storage Full' bottlenecks and permanently adds +5 slots (from 40 to 45) by combining the free Storage Camera with two SimCash-purchased storage parts.
preconditions: 1 Storage Camera collected from a citizen bubble and 36 SimCash available for the remaining 2 parts
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Open City Storage from the top-left bar or building, click 'Increase Capacity', purchase the missing Lock and Bars, and confirm.

steps.who: blue water-droplet thought bubble on the residential building

steps.briefing: collect the special Storage Camera item into storage.

steps.who: City Storage icon on the left HUD (or City Storage building)
steps.briefing: open the City Storage inventory window.
open the Upgrade City Storage requirements.

steps.who: two yellow '18 SimCash' buttons next to Storage Lock and Storage Bars
steps.briefing: purchase the two missing special items.
complete the upgrade to increase City Storage capacity from 40 to 45.
